pages.text: The hopeless aim and pitiful damage of blazes made you furious, so in a fit of anger you designed this focus. Cast to summon your own Drought Blazes; wrapped in the scorching heat of the drought-scorched hills, they are far stronger than ordinary blazes.
Cast while sneaking to gather them to your side, sixteen at most around you. Cast with a Nether Staff and you summon more at once.
